svg.title: Implemented history-span baseline and unimplemented evidence-acquisition candidate
svg.desc: Left: π0.5 FrameSamp+Modul, sampled public history, native action loss and one absorption round. Right: an unimplemented training-only belief-conditioned recovery planner. Both panels reset memory on independent instances. No new algorithm or outcome is claimed.
svg.text: What exists, and what remains a research question
Deployment corrections → future autonomy: an existing problem, not a certified novelty claim
A · Implemented baseline
B · Candidate only / NOT IMPLEMENTED
π0.5 / FrameSamp+Modul · research snapshot b3c1473
Closest overlap: A2D, CritiQ/ReTRy, sensing imitation
Public observations + native demo
Initial video and self-interaction share the history.
No simulator secrets or oracle subgoals in student inputs.
Same-budget history-span control
Uniformly spanning ≤32 frames vs most recent ≤32.
512 memory tokens; current inputs and action targets match.
Reuse the original native model
FrameSamp visual tokens → memory modulation → actions.
Native JAX backend and native action normalization.
One source-corpus absorption round
Executed correction chunks are action-loss targets.
No new collector policy or learned help-request mechanism.
Student-visible evidence, not the hidden answer
A belief over configurations consistent with public history.
Identical histories must imply the same action distribution.
Training-only sensing → recovery planner
Use legal sensing actions, then visible consequences.
Count planning, failed candidates, teacher calls and resets.
Native learner and masked correction loss
Keep the true prefix; suppress targets, not observations.
Same demo allocation and token budget across comparisons.
Fresh deployment with teacher removed
Reset instance memory; acquire new evidence independently.
Measure task success and expert cost, not training loss.
A is student-state BC / one-round DAgger; no algorithm claim.
B proceeds only after a distinct, falsifiable gap is established.
Evidence boundary
100-case initial baseline: 32/50 + 10/50 = 42%. Evaluation coordinator interrupted by SSH; no complete learning conclusion.
